description: Product detect TRT engines baked into the video-det image. No PyTorch checkpoints. Object keys are s3://mintonix-{dev,prod}/models/<file>. Engines are TRT/GPU-stack specific — rebuild and re-upload when the Dockerfile base or target GPU arch changes.
